question: Should OpenClaw standardize `commands list/inspect` and the proposed plugin descriptor metadata as its supported operator inventory contract alongside Gateway `commands.list`?
rationale: The namespace, stable schema, registry ownership, plugin API surface, and relationship to the existing Gateway inventory are durable product and compatibility choices that cannot be resolved mechanically.

options.title: Ratify minimal commands v1
options.body: Approve list and inspect with explicit load errors, narrowly stable fields, documented plugin metadata, and a clear separation from Gateway inventory.

options.title: Adopt broader catalog
options.body: Choose the distinct catalog namespace and explicitly own richer operational lenses and their compatibility guarantees.

options.title: Defer command aggregation
options.body: Keep existing inventories separate until a shared command model and durable consumer justify another public contract.

recommendation.title: Ratify minimal commands v1
recommendation.body: Approve list and inspect with explicit load errors, narrowly stable fields, documented plugin metadata, and a clear separation from Gateway inventory.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the repository's RFC acceptance lifecycle and are the strongest available coordinator for the required product decision.
